title: Pages — the shell, round 8: four things you saw but never answered

steps.headline: The library header is the title left, Make a page and Esc · Back right; cards group under Personal, then each project.
steps.changed: This is the screen from round 1 with the later fixes applied. The contract writer found that the header and the grouping were only ever seen beside a note, never answered on their own.
steps.notice: Same family as Projects: one header, content below it on the plain background.

steps.path: The band across the top of an open page
steps.headline: The band has no line under it, the page's name sits in the exact centre, and the panel starts hidden.
steps.changed: From your notes in rounds 4 and 7: the pane's edge is the divider; the name is centred by construction; the panel is hidden until you press the top-left button (your call in the interview: always default to hidden).
steps.notice: Opening a page shows the page, not the list.

steps.headline: With the panel shown, panel and page are two rounded panes inset by the same edge on every side.
steps.changed: The full view with the panel open, as it stands after rounds 5 and 6. Never answered on its own; only its parts were.
steps.measured: 10 px edge on every side; panel 240 px
steps.notice: The window, the panel and the page share one rhythm.

steps.path: Click another page in the panel
steps.headline: Clicking a page in the panel opens it in place; the band's name and icon follow.
steps.changed: Round 4 showed this beside a note about a margin, which is since fixed. Nothing else changed.
steps.notice: Switching pages is one click, like switching sessions in the strip.
steps.risk: Switching reloads the page; anything the page has not saved is lost. Pages save their data as they go, so this is rarely visible.
